jobs_results.title: DevOps Expert
jobs_results.description:
As the world’s largest cloud platform provider, CloudBlue orchestrates B2B ecosystems by enabling management of traditional and digital products and subscriptions. CloudBlue is the only cloud commerce engine with a proven hyper-scale digital platform, powering service provider marketplaces totaling more than 30 million seats globally. At CloudBlue, you’ll join a dynamic, multicultural company led by forward-thinkers. We have a fast paced and agile environment offering start-up energy with the freedom to be creative and make a difference while enjoying the security of a large company backed by multi-billion parent company, Ingram Micro.

Our values contribute to making our company one of the best places to work.

We take pride in:

Our Trust in our Team

We leverage every voice and collaborate at every level. We hire talented, accountable individuals and encourage high levels of responsibility.

Our Creative Engine

You will never stop learning and enjoy the challenge of finding... innovative solutions to empower our customers to achieve greatness.

Our Strive for Excellence

We’re aspirational in our leadership and we take pride and ownership in delivering the best.

Our Passion & Energy

We run fast, manage ambiguity, courageously take risks, and are resilient in our pursuit of ambitious goals.

At CloudBlue, we constantly innovate and follow a customer-first approach, which requires flexibility and adaptability. We work hard, laugh together, and support each other as we pursue massive opportunities in the cloud market.

Come join us and help lead the XaaS revolution.

We are looking for a DevOps engineer for our Cloudblue SaaS service. You will do design, architecture, troubleshoot and development of the infrastructure – both R&D related and production related.

What you'll be doing
• Challenge and redefine existing architectural fundamentals in order to provide next level of performance and scalability; ability to foresee post-deployment design challenges, performance and scale bottlenecks
• Design and develop highly-scalable elastic cloud architecture that seamlessly integrates with on-premises systems
• Design and develop a CI/CD of the platform
• Design and develop a microservices architectural framework
• Document and maintain software functionality

What you need
• A Senior Software Engineer is expected to have more than 3 years of solid, active commercial software development work, including significant personal ownership of projects or initiatives.
• Knowledge in CI/CD practices, Infrastructure as a Code practices, DevOps techniques
• Proficient in Azure, AKS(Kubernetes), Terraform, Docker, Python.
• Experience in Jenkins: pipelines, groovy.
• Experience in Linux, Ansible.
• Experience in Git (Bitbucket), Monitoring(Zabbix, Grafana), Logging (Kibana)
• Good written English and speaking skills

The ideal applicant will have a strong working knowledge of many of the following
• Demonstrated success designing and developing complex systems
• Expertise with multi-tenant, highly complex, cloud solutions. Experience with Hybrid and/or on premises solutions desired
• Experience in development and/or maintenance of highly loaded enterprise-grade systems
• Experience owning all aspects of software engineering, from design to implementation, QA and maintenance
• End-to-end experience in design and development of highly-scalable enterprise and cloud data products
• Experience in AWS/GCP management

jobs_results.title: DevOps Jr. Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Eviden is an Atos Group business with an annual revenue of circa € 5 billion and a global leader in data-driven, trusted and sustainable digital transformation. As a next generation digital business with worldwide leading positions in digital, cloud, data, advanced computing and security, it brings deep expertise for all industries in more than 47 countries. By uniting unique high-end technologies across the full digital continuum with 55,000 world-class talents, Eviden expands the possibilities of data and technology, now and for generations to come.

We are looking for a DevOps Jr. Engineer to join our diverse innovation team in Eviden.

We offer a position in a dynamic product-oriented team in an international environment for our Research and Innovation department to develop your carrier.

Mandatory Skills
• BS/MS in SW Engineering or Telco Engineer
• Programming languages such as C/C++, Python, R...
• 2+ years of work experience in containers and container orchestration using... Docker, Kubernetes, or other relevant tools/frameworks.
• Experience and skills on CI/CD. Proficiency in Git
• 2+ years of experience in developing microservices or APIs.
• Good analytical, time management and teamwork skills.
• English level B2.

Desirable Skills
• Any of the following:
• Demonstrable experience of RedHat Linux OS based infrastructure, RPM, as well as general Linux support skills
• Experience in Jenkins (including writing Jenkins files and managing Jenkins plugins)
• Experience in programming language as Go and infra-automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform
• Logging: ELK (Elastic, Logstash & Kibana)
• Monitoring: Prometheus & Grafana.
• Proficiency in Git, writing test cases and performing code reviews
• English level C1

Benefits:

• Competitive remuneration package.

• Extensive training programs.

• Flexible working schedule.

• Long-term career opportunities and professional growth in a global company.

Let’s grow together

jobs_results.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Join a team that is changing millions of lives.

Transforming smiles, changing lives

 

At Align Technology, we believe a great smile can transform a person’s life, so we create technology that gives people the confidence to take on whatever’s next. We revolutionized the orthodontic industry with the introduction of the Invisalign system, and we have never lost sight of that spirit of innovation. Our diverse and collaborative teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 

Ready to join us? 

About this opportunity

Align is expanding its team in Madrid, Spain. This energetic and highly technical team is responsible for creating the next generation of our operational platform infrastructure to expedite the development and delivery of software in the digital medical device space. We work closely with engineering teams to become highly efficient and autonomous by providing automated solutions wherever practical. This is a great opportunity to combine the latest... tools and technologies with cutting-edge approaches to build the best development platform in the industry.

We are looking for a candidate for the Operations Services team. We are an integrational team. Our responsibilities include the development of API Services on Java Spring. The services provide access to backend systems in Amazon Cloud. Backend systems include ML models and file processing components on C++ etc. The team consists of Java developers, DevOps and SQA.

In this role, you will…

This individual contributor role will need to keep up to date with all modern technologies in the field of cloud infrastructure operations and release engineering (often referred to as “devops”). That skill set will be applied across the following activities:
• Collaborate with development teams on implementing deployment and packaging automation for their apps using Docker, CloudFormation, Terraform, kubernetes, or other appropriate technologies
• Participate in strategic projects to improve Align’s approach to cloud-based infrastructure and application deployment
• Develop solutions to automate repetitive tasks, monitor system health, create and update real-time inventories and reports, and improve existing processes
• Participate in shaping and improving SDLC processes and document them in Standard Operating Procedures

In this role, you’ll need …
• Proficiency in speaking and writing English
• Masters or Bachelors in Computer Science or equivalent experience
• 2+ years working in a cloud (AWS preferred)
• 5+ years working on systems admin level with Linux and/or Windows
• Experience with any of docker orchestration tools (K8S, Docker Swarm, Rancher)
• Experience working with configuration and/or infrastructure management frameworks (Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)
• Familiarity with modern container technologies
• Experience deploying, troubleshooting, and maintaining distributed systems and/or client-server applications
• Strong skills in one or more of the following programming languages: Python
• Ability to learn quickly

Sound like a good fit? 

 

Great! Click the "Apply" link to let us know you are interested. Not the right fit? Don’t worry, Align is quickly growing so we are creating more opportunities to expand our Align family. Please consider joining our Talent Network to receive notifications about future jobs or sharing this opportunity with others in your network.    

 

About Align  

  

Align Technology is a publicly traded medical device company that is transforming smiles and changing lives. Our global team of talented employees develop innovative technology, tools and treatment options to help dental professionals worldwide achieve the clinical results they expect. Our digital ecosystem combines the power of technology to create beautiful smiles through the integration of AI and machine learning, digital imaging and visualization, biomechanics and material science to develop the Invisalign system, the most advanced clear aligner system in the world; iTero Intraoral Scanners and OrthoCAD digital services. Did you know? Align is the world’s largest manufacturer of custom 3D-printed materials.   

  

By joining Align, you will be part of a global, fast-growing company in one of the most dynamic industries. Great people, innovative technologies, and meaningful work – these are just some of the things employees say make Align Technology a great place to work.   

  

We respect your privacy. Please review our Applicant Privacy Policies for additional information.  

 

Global Diversity Statement:

At Align, we believe in the power of a smile, and we know that every smile is as unique as our employees. As we grow, we will continue building a workforce of diverse cultural backgrounds and life experiences and fostering a culture of open-mindedness and compassion for all our employees. We live our company values by promoting healthy people and healthy communities. All with the intent of changing millions of lives, one unique smile at a time.

Equal Opportunity Statement

It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity in all of our employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Applicants for positions with Align must be legally authorized to work in the country which they are applying for and verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire.

#LI-Hybrid

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

We are in Business for People, empowering people in service organizations with innovative Enterprise and Business software solutions. We’ve innovated and taken a new approach to delivering ERP that works for people. Self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software that is changing the way people work. Our solutions empower people and deliver a better people experience so people can spend time on meaningful high value work they live for.

Read more on our website about how we transform work and how people feel about it, so our customers and their people can thrive.

Job Description

As a DevOps Automation Engineer you will:
• work with our Cloud Operations Engineers to contribute to new features and ideas.
• produce status reports detailing project activities.
• work with Service Delivery on problem remediation via automation and scripting
• work with cross-functional technical teams to extended automation capabilities
• identify and deploy internal process and... automation improvements
• work as a Technical escalation point for the global Ops support team
• contribute to the development and maintenance of the existing Azure pipelines, Azure boards, and Git repositories, with a roadmap of key deliverables and timelines
• create and maintain detailed and accurate documentation, knowledge base articles.

Qualifications
• Excellent verbal and written communication
• Good Windows Server OS knowledge
• Advanced knowledge of PowerShell
• Good Knowledge of Active Directory
• Experience with JSON files
• Knowledge of Application deployment
• Continuous improvement mindset
• Attention to detail and a security-minded approach to solving problems
• Strong problem-solving skills. The ability to adapt and overcome is a must
• Ability to drive concurrent projects and initiatives while managing operational issues
• Comfortable working in hyper-growth environments
• Knowledge and experience with Azure Resource Manager templates (ARM)
• Knowledge on CI CD pipelines

Nice to have
• Azure Administrator certification
• Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification

Additional Information

A chance to participate in the development of a leading global software firm. You have the opportunity to work within an organization, that gives you the freedom and autonomy to be successful. An attractive salary while working in a challenging international environment with enthusiastic colleagues who like to learn from each other.

At Unit4 we invest in your personal and professional growth. We don't focus on how many days you work, we trust you on delivering results - thus, we have an unlimited vacation policy

jobs_results.title: AWS DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Engineer to join Cloud project team. The ideal candidate will have a strong skills and experience in planning, coding, development, testing, release and deployment of AWS services using AWS native tools.
Our Cloud project team is setting up AWS platform and services. Planning & designing of AWS platform is complete. Building & testing of AWS platform is in progress. Cloud service setup is also in progress. From April applications are expected to host applications in AWS platform/environment.

Your Day-to-Day:
In this role, you will be responsible for building and qualifying AWS services. You will work closely with Architecture, Operations, Network, Service SME and Security teams to ensure the smooth development and release of AWS services.
• Plan, code, build, test and release AWS services
• Support operations team in deployment of AWS services using IaC
• Ensure configuration and compliance of AWS services using AWS native tools
• Participate... and contribute in development of CI/CD pipeline
• Development of Infrastructure products and deploying with Service Catalog portfolio
• Work on automation backlog
• Work on documentation
• Monitor application performance
• Troubleshoot and resolve issues with AWS services
• Provide effective utilization of AWS services
• Support application/development teams to deploy applications onto AWS environment
• Collaborate with other IT teams to ensure the smooth operation of the overall AWS services

What you need:
• 3+ years of experience as DevOps Engineer
• Experience with CloudShell, CodeBuild, CodeCommit,
• Experience with AWS CloudFormation
• Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash)
• Experience with JSON, YAML
• Experience in automation of AWS Service Catalog portfolio and product deployment by using AWS Cloud Development Kit
• Knowledge of security best practices in AWS cloud
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Nice to haves:
• Experience with Terraform
• Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and ECS
• Experience with database administration, particularly RDS and Aurora
• Knowledge of agile software development methodologies

Benefits:
• Advantage of working in a large, stable, and reliable company, which managed to keep a dynamic and friendly work environment.
• Experience in international projects for first-rate global companies.
• Attractive salary and compensation package (advanced health insurance, flexible cell phone compensation, etc.)
• Company-sponsored professional training and certifications.
• Active/passive participation in professional international conferences.
• Career growth and opportunities for development.
• Regular company and team-building events.
• Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere (depending on the project

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with more than 3 years of experience. You will be:
• Monitoring system performance and resolving issues to ensure optimal functionality, efficiency, and security of the IT infrastructure.
• Conducting routine maintenance tasks, including application updates or downgrades.
• Addressing and resolving Helpdesk queries to offer support to internal departments.
• Managing user access and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) according to compliance policies.
• Participating in paid on-call duties on a rotating basis, with one-week shifts every three weeks.
• Designing, documenting, and implementing security policies for system protection.
• Leveraging continuous integration tools to identify development issues proactively.
• Creating automated deployment systems through configuration management technologies.
• At least 3 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong proven experience in the administration of Linux-based systems
• Strong experience with... Docker & Kubernetes.
• Fluent in Spanish and English.
• Proven experience working with AWS or Azure.
• Proven experience managing databases and networks
• Proven experience with continuous integration tools (like Jenkins) and monitoring tools (like Riemann, Prometheus, Grafana, or ElasticSearch)
• Critical thinking and great problem-solving skills
• Knowledge of security systems and data backup/recovery will be a plus
• Knowledge of tools like Ansible/Terraform will be a plus

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
As a DevOps/Azure Cloud Engineer in our DevOps team, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure on the Azure platform. You will work closely with software development teams, ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of our applications and services. This role requires strong technical expertise in Azure, DevOps best practices, and a proactive mindset to drive continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:
• Design and deploy DevOps solutions on Azure cloud, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure Functions, and Azure App Service;
• Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to automate build, test, and deployment workflows using Visual Studio, PowerShell, Git, and Azure CLI;
• Manage and optimize Azure cloud infrastructure, including virtual machines, storage accounts, networks, and security groups;
• Monitor and troubleshoot performance and availability of Azure applications using Azure Monitor... Application Insights, and Log Analytics;
• Advocate for DevOps best practices and foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement within the organization.

Why we would like to have a dialogue with you

We pick competencies over skills and experience. Can you convince us that you possess the following competencies:
• Proactiveness: The ability to anticipate and take initiative in addressing potential challenges or opportunities before they arise, demonstrating foresight and proactive problem-solving.
• Innovation: The ability to generate and implement new and innovative ideas to solve problems and create new business opportunities.
• Continuous learning & knowledge sharing: The ability and willingness to learn continuously throughout one's life, and to continuously seek out new knowledge and skills to stay up-to-date and relevant.
• Collaboration: The ability to work effectively with others and to build strong relationships based on trust and mutual respect, recognizing that everyone has something to contribute.
• Agile mindset: The ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances, and to pivot or adjust strategies as needed to remain competitive and relevant.
• Systems thinking: The ability to understand the interdependencies and complexities of a business or project, and to develop integrated solutions that are scalable and adaptable to future changes.
• Adaptability: The ability to adjust to changing situations and work effectively in environments that may be uncertain or unpredictable.

Competencies are key, but to be successful in this role you need to bring a few essentials to kickstart the conversation:
• Azure cloud platform expertis
• DevOps automation proficiency
• Infrastructure management skills
• Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (agile, CI/CD)
• Proficient in Microsoft technologies and tools, such as .NET Framework/Core, C#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API/Core, Entity Framework/Core, etc
• Several years of experience in software development and DevOps engineering

Some last notes

Hybrid or remote?

As we have a remote working policy in The Netherlands, we expect you to be at the office twice a week. In all the other countries, we have a remote working policy. As the location of this role is flexible (UK, ES or NL); it depends on the location of the role which benefits you'll enjoy. If you get invited for the first screening call with the recruiter, we are happy to tell you more about those.

But the real reason to choose us? You get the opportunity to experience what it's like to work with proud, smart, devoted and cooperative colleagues who are passionate about our dialogue products and Microsoft technology. Just like you, they go the extra mile to deliver top-notch solutions. If this sounds like what you’re looking for to find in a team, then we definitely tick that box!

Anywhere365 is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We accept difference and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Azure)
jobs_results.description:
At PayRetailers, we are committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses to succeed in Latin America. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages creativity and growth, where every employee's contribution is valued. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with us, as we strive to make a meaningful impact on the world of payments.

Our Tech team is looking for a DevOps Engineer with experience in Azure for our new office in Sofia. This is a key player role for establishing and growing the product development teams in Bulgaria.

Experience and Qualifications:
• Develop & Optimize: Craft and scale cloud-native solutions in Azure. Your mission is to make our cloud setup smarter, faster, and more efficient.
• Team Up: Join forces with application teams on cloud projects. Enhance our CI/CD pipelines for smoother, quicker deployments.
• Explore & Implement: Dive into cloud engineering, focusing on innovative infrastructure solutions that tackle complex... challenges.
• Brings 3+ years of experience with MS Azure and a total of 5+ years in the DevOps arena to the table. AWS gurus willing and able to learn fast are also welcome.
• Understands containerization concepts and is eager to apply this knowledge in a practical setting.
• Has a grasp of cloud security, networking, and is familiar with web apps, integration scenarios and databases (Postgres, NoSQL).
• Has profound knowledge in Azure cloud network security and deeply understands the concepts of private endpoints, private DNS and traffic routing.
• Is comfortable navigating GitOps and CI/CD tools, with a knack for scripting (Bash, Python) and Bitbucket pipelining.
• Knows the ins and outs of APIM and authentication flows, including authentication mechanisms for PaaS, JWT tokens and B2C model, ensuring our applications are both secure and scalable.
• Expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and JSON driven terraform infrastructure.
• Be at the forefront of our cloud journey in Sofia, directly shaping our infrastructure and deployment strategies.
• Enjoy a role that blends strategic planning with hands-on execution in a dynamic, agile environment.
• Seize opportunities for professional growth in a setting that values innovation and practical problem-solving.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary
• Opportunities to grow within a company in hypergrowth stage
• Additional days of holidays
• Free language classes
• Free Multisport card
• Possibility of working from home up to 4 days per week during the first months

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (full remote / hybrid)
jobs_results.description:
Based in Barcelona, Qustodio is a fast-growing internet safety startup whose mission is to provide a safe digital experience for every child. Our top product is a multi-platform parental control solution that is used and loved by hundreds of thousands of families worldwide, and is one of the leading brands worldwide in the Digital Wellbeing category.

Qustodio is growing and we have some amazing challenges to face. From our Operation Team, we provide service to hundreds of thousand of users all around the world. We have an already well established and high performance platform that provides high availability and to our users. At this point of our evolution, we are looking to add a new member to our operations team that helps us to keep improving our platform and to keep improving pipelines and procedures.

What is our mission as a team?

The platform team is aimed to keep evolving our infrastructure providing the technological infrastructure for bringing our customers the greatest... experience. We are encourage to modernize our well established system to be more flexible, stand on high quality standards and help teams to bring features and improvements faster.

So, if you:
• Have experience managing orchestrated environments like Kubernetes
• Knows about Helm charts and knows how to craft them
• Care about quality and like to get things done the right way
• Have a comprehensive knowledge on networking
• Feel the need of having ownership on challenges
• Have expertise with the AWS services ecosystem
• Are interested in making things agile: by understanding and applying automation

What can we offer you:
• Great culture - friendly and emphasises both teamwork and fun.
• Our company is home to over 15 nationalities.
• Flexible working hours - and there are possibilities to work from home.
• Interesting challenges in a fast-growing technology company for you to grind your skills.
• Competitive salary range.
• Private health insurance.
• In-house training and team building events.
• A modern and fully equipped office headquarters in Barcelona city center,
• Daily fruit and beverages supply.
• Daily catering for lunch.
• 23 days of holidays per year. Half day off on your b'day.
• Flexible benefits
